connector.name: MCP Debug Recorder by oaslananka (oaslananka-debug-recorder-mcp)
connector.registryDescription: Record debug sessions, commands, failed attempts, and successful fixes in local SQLite storage.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package debug-recorder-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oaslananka account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_DB
env.description: Override the SQLite database location for local debug history.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Set the minimum structured log level: debug, info, warn, or error.

env.name: FUZZY_THRESHOLD
env.description: Override the Fuse.js threshold used during fuzzy reranking.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_REDACT_BEFORE_STORE
env.description: Set to true to redact common secret patterns before persisting debug text.

env.name: HOST
env.description: HTTP bind host for optional Streamable HTTP mode. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP port for optional Streamable HTTP mode.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_HTTP_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for optional Streamable HTTP mode. Required for non-loopback bind.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated HTTP Host allowlist for optional Streamable HTTP mode.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for optional Streamable HTTP mode.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_MAX_BODY_BYTES
env.description: Maximum JSON body size for optional Streamable HTTP mode.

env.name: DEBUG_RECORDER_REMOTE_HTTP
env.description: Must be true to allow optional Streamable HTTP mode to bind outside loopback.
